## Setup

All inputs are read relative to this file: the Global SOC Fractions dataset and
your reference assignments from `Global_SOC_crops/`, and the DayCent model
results from `../Project_CABBI/outputs/summary/` (rerun the Project_CABBI
pipeline to refresh them). The previous version of this notebook is in
`archive/SOCMetaAnalysis_2025-11-12.Rmd`.

```{r libraries}
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(ggplot2)

# DATA NOT INCLUDED: the Global Soil Carbon Fractions: Regenerative + Conventional Croplands
# dataset is not redistributed in this repository. It is available through LandEngine
# (https://landengine.org/). Citation: A. M. Prairie, A. E. King, and M. F. Cotrufo, "Restoring
# particulate and mineral-associated organic carbon through regenerative agriculture," Proc. Natl.
# Acad. Sci., vol. 120, no. 21, p. e2217481120, May 2023, doi: 10.1073/pnas.2217481120.
# Place globalsocfractions_crops.csv and the reference-assignment file
# globalsocfractions_crops_filtered_top20_referenced.csv in Global_SOC_crops/.
data_dir <- "Global_SOC_crops"
model_dir <- file.path("..", "Project_CABBI", "outputs", "summary")
shared_drive <- "G:/Shared drives/Bio+ Soil Carbon Accounting - ICCT/Technical Work"

target_depth_cm <- 20  # matches the DayCent soil pools (fix.100 EDEPTH = 0.20 m)
c_to_co2 <- 44 / 12

practice_labels <- c(NT = "No-till", RT = "Reduced-till", CC = "Cover crop")
practice_colors <- c(NT = "#2a78d6", RT = "#eb6834", CC = "#1baf7a")
```

## Global data

Global Soil Carbon Fractions: Regenerative + Conventional Croplands

- studies investigating the response of SOC pools to three soil management
  practices: tillage, cropping intensification, and integrated crop-livestock
- only points where the treatment of interest is isolated within the
  experimental design

```{r data}
dd <- read.csv(file.path(data_dir, "globalsocfractions_crops.csv"), header = TRUE)

# Corn systems with a reported SOC stock; keep every layer of each profile
crop_species_cols <- grep("^crop[0-9]_species$", names(dd), value = TRUE)
df <- dd %>%
  filter(if_any(all_of(crop_species_cols), ~ !is.na(.) & . == "corn")) %>%
  filter(!is.na(total_MgC_ha)) %>%
  select(paper_id, sid, tid, soil_depth_upper, soil_depth_lower, location, duration,
         tillage, tillage_details, crop_rotation_name, CC, avg_Nfert_rate, soil_BD,
         total_MgC_ha, total_MgC_ha_sd, reps, total_gC_kg_soil, crop_scsc, perennial,
         total_cropping_intensity)

cat("Corn layers with SOC stocks:", nrow(df), " trials:",
    nrow(distinct(df, paper_id, sid, tid)), "\n")
```

## Harmonize SOC stocks to 0-20 cm (fixed depth)

Each trial (paper_id, sid, tid) is one sampled profile. Layers wholly above
20 cm are summed; a layer that spans 20 cm contributes the share above 20 cm,
assuming uniform SOC within the layer. Only profiles that start at 0 cm and
reach at least 20 cm without gaps are kept.

```{r fixed-depth-0-20}
profiles <- df %>%
  arrange(paper_id, sid, tid, soil_depth_upper) %>%
  group_by(paper_id, sid, tid) %>%
  mutate(thickness_cm = soil_depth_lower - soil_depth_upper,
         contiguous = soil_depth_upper == lag(soil_depth_lower, default = 0)) %>%
  ungroup()

profile_checks <- profiles %>%
  group_by(paper_id, sid, tid) %>%
  summarise(starts_at_0 = min(soil_depth_upper) == 0,
            max_depth = max(soil_depth_lower),
            contiguous_to_20 = all(contiguous[soil_depth_upper < target_depth_cm]),
            duplicated_layers = any(duplicated(paste(soil_depth_upper, soil_depth_lower))),
            .groups = "drop") %>%
  mutate(usable = starts_at_0 & max_depth >= target_depth_cm & contiguous_to_20 &
           !duplicated_layers)

top20 <- profiles %>%
  semi_join(filter(profile_checks, usable), by = c("paper_id", "sid", "tid")) %>%
  filter(soil_depth_upper < target_depth_cm) %>%
  mutate(share_above_20 = pmin(1, (target_depth_cm - soil_depth_upper) / thickness_cm)) %>%
  group_by(paper_id, sid, tid) %>%
  summarise(MgC_ha_top20_fd = sum(total_MgC_ha * share_above_20), .groups = "drop")

cat("Profiles usable for 0-20 cm:", nrow(top20), "of", nrow(profile_checks), "\n")
```

## Pair treatments with their reference (your manual assignments)

`Reference` IDs come from your hand-assigned file: the reference (control)
row ends in `R`, and every treatment row with the same ID is compared to it.
Comparisons are classified by the change in tillage or cover crop as before.

```{r pairs}
ref_assign <- read.csv(file.path(data_dir, "globalsocfractions_crops_filtered_top20_referenced.csv"),
                       header = TRUE, check.names = TRUE) %>%
  filter(!is.na(Reference), Reference != "", Reference != "X") %>%
  select(paper_id, sid, tid, Reference, MgC_ha_top20_file = MgC_ha_top20)

trials <- profiles %>%
  distinct(paper_id, sid, tid, location, duration, tillage, CC, crop_rotation_name,
           avg_Nfert_rate) %>%
  inner_join(ref_assign, by = c("paper_id", "sid", "tid")) %>%
  left_join(top20, by = c("paper_id", "sid", "tid"))

# The recomputed 0-20 cm stocks should match the stocks in the referenced file
stopifnot(isTRUE(all.equal(trials$MgC_ha_top20_fd, trials$MgC_ha_top20_file)))

ref_rows <- trials %>%
  filter(grepl("R$", Reference)) %>%
  transmute(ref_id = sub("R$", "", Reference),
            ref_paper_id = paper_id, ref_sid = sid, ref_tid = tid,
            tillage_ref = tillage, CC_ref = CC, MgC_ha_top20_fd_ref = MgC_ha_top20_fd)

pairs <- trials %>%
  filter(!grepl("R$", Reference)) %>%
  mutate(ref_id = Reference) %>%
  inner_join(ref_rows, by = "ref_id") %>%
  mutate(TillChange = case_when(
           tillage == "NT" & tillage_ref == "CT" ~ "NT",
           tillage == "RT" & tillage_ref == "CT" ~ "RT",
           tillage == tillage_ref ~ "NoChange",
           TRUE ~ NA_character_),
         CCChange = case_when(
           CC == "yes" & CC_ref == "no" ~ "CC",
           CC == CC_ref ~ "NoChange",
           TRUE ~ NA_character_),
         Change = case_when(
           TillChange == "NoChange" & CCChange == "NoChange" ~ "Conv",
           TillChange == "NoChange" & CCChange == "CC" ~ "CC",
           TillChange == "NT" & CCChange == "NoChange" ~ "NT",
           TillChange == "RT" & CCChange == "NoChange" ~ "RT",
           TillChange != "NoChange" & CCChange != "NoChange" ~ "BothCCandTillChange",
           TRUE ~ NA_character_),
         delta_fd = MgC_ha_top20_fd - MgC_ha_top20_fd_ref,
         rate_fd = delta_fd / duration)

pairs %>% count(Change, name = "comparisons")
```

## Equivalent soil mass (studies reporting bulk density)

No-till and other practices change bulk density, so a fixed 0-20 cm depth can
contain different amounts of soil in the treatment and reference plots. For
each pair where both profiles report bulk density for every layer, the
treatment SOC is taken at the same soil mass as the reference's top 20 cm:

- soil mass per layer (Mg/ha) = bulk density (g/cm3) x thickness (cm) x 100
- reference: SOC and soil mass to 20 cm (identical to the fixed-depth value)
- treatment: cumulative SOC interpolated linearly against cumulative soil mass
  at the reference mass (uniform SOC within a layer, as in the fixed-depth
  proration); if the treatment profile holds less soil than the reference
  mass, the deepest layer's SOC per unit soil is extended (flagged)

This uses total soil mass and linear interpolation; von Haden et al. (2020)
use mineral soil mass and a monotone spline, which needs SOM data per layer.

```{r equivalent-soil-mass}
profile_mass <- profiles %>%
  semi_join(filter(profile_checks, usable), by = c("paper_id", "sid", "tid")) %>%
  group_by(paper_id, sid, tid) %>%
  filter(all(!is.na(soil_BD))) %>%
  arrange(soil_depth_upper, .by_group = TRUE) %>%
  mutate(soil_mass_Mg_ha = soil_BD * thickness_cm * 100,
         cum_mass = cumsum(soil_mass_Mg_ha),
         cum_soc = cumsum(total_MgC_ha)) %>%
  ungroup()

# Soil mass in a profile's top 20 cm
mass_to_20 <- profile_mass %>%
  filter(soil_depth_upper < target_depth_cm) %>%
  mutate(share_above_20 = pmin(1, (target_depth_cm - soil_depth_upper) / thickness_cm)) %>%
  group_by(paper_id, sid, tid) %>%
  summarise(ref_mass_20 = sum(soil_mass_Mg_ha * share_above_20), .groups = "drop")

# SOC at a given cumulative soil mass in one profile
soc_at_mass <- function(profile, target_mass) {
  mass <- c(0, profile$cum_mass)
  soc <- c(0, profile$cum_soc)
  if (target_mass <= max(mass)) {
    return(list(soc = approx(mass, soc, xout = target_mass)$y, extrapolated = FALSE))
  }
  deepest <- profile[nrow(profile), ]
  extra <- (target_mass - max(mass)) * deepest$total_MgC_ha / deepest$soil_mass_Mg_ha
  list(soc = max(soc) + extra, extrapolated = TRUE)
}

esm <- pairs %>%
  inner_join(mass_to_20, by = c("ref_paper_id" = "paper_id", "ref_sid" = "sid",
                                "ref_tid" = "tid")) %>%
  semi_join(distinct(profile_mass, paper_id, sid, tid), by = c("paper_id", "sid", "tid"))

esm_values <- lapply(seq_len(nrow(esm)), function(i) {
  treatment <- profile_mass %>%
    filter(paper_id == esm$paper_id[i], sid == esm$sid[i], tid == esm$tid[i])
  soc_at_mass(treatment, esm$ref_mass_20[i])
})
esm <- esm %>%
  mutate(MgC_ha_esm = vapply(esm_values, `[[`, numeric(1), "soc"),
         esm_extrapolated = vapply(esm_values, `[[`, logical(1), "extrapolated"),
         delta_esm = MgC_ha_esm - MgC_ha_top20_fd_ref,
         rate_esm = delta_esm / duration) %>%
  select(paper_id, sid, tid, ref_id, ref_mass_20, MgC_ha_esm, esm_extrapolated,
         delta_esm, rate_esm)

pairs <- pairs %>% left_join(esm, by = c("paper_id", "sid", "tid", "ref_id"))

cat("Pairs with an equivalent-soil-mass estimate:", sum(!is.na(pairs$rate_esm)), "of",
    nrow(pairs), "; extrapolated below the deepest layer:",
    sum(pairs$esm_extrapolated, na.rm = TRUE), "\n")
```

## Average to one result per study

When a paper reports more than one comparison for the same practice change,
the comparisons are averaged so each study counts once. `delta_*` is the net
SOC difference from the conventional reference (Mg C/ha) and `rate_*` is that
difference divided by duration (Mg C/ha/yr), each averaged across comparisons.

```{r study-averages}
study <- pairs %>%
  filter(Change %in% names(practice_labels)) %>%
  group_by(paper_id, Change) %>%
  summarise(sid = paste(unique(sid), collapse = ";"),
            location = paste(unique(location), collapse = ";"),
            n_comparisons = n(),
            duration = mean(duration),
            delta_fd = mean(delta_fd),
            rate_fd = mean(rate_fd),
            n_esm = sum(!is.na(rate_esm)),
            delta_esm = if (any(!is.na(delta_esm))) mean(delta_esm, na.rm = TRUE) else NA_real_,
            rate_esm = if (any(!is.na(rate_esm))) mean(rate_esm, na.rm = TRUE) else NA_real_,
            .groups = "drop") %>%
  relocate(paper_id, sid, location, duration, Change) %>%
  mutate(Change = factor(Change, levels = names(practice_labels)))

study %>% count(Change, name = "studies")
```

## Variance-weighted meta-analysis and heterogeneity

Every comparison reports the SD of the SOC stock per layer and the number of
replicates for both the practice and the reference plots, so each net SOC rate
has a sampling variance:

- 0-20 cm SD of a profile: layer SDs prorated like the stocks and combined
  assuming the layers are perfectly correlated across plots (sum of SDs). This
  gives the larger, conservative SD; assuming independent layers (root sum of
  squares) is a sensitivity analysis.
- variance of a rate = (SD_practice^2 / n_practice + SD_reference^2 / n_reference) / duration^2.
  Comparisons that share a reference plot share its variance, so their errors
  are correlated.
- study-level effect: the mean of the study's comparisons, with the variance of
  that mean including the shared-reference covariance.
- ESM rates use the fixed-depth variances (the papers report SDs at fixed
  depths only), so the ESM results are a sensitivity analysis.

Each practice is fitted separately with a random-effects model (REML) and the
Knapp-Hartung adjustment, which keeps the confidence interval honest with few
studies. The multilevel model uses every comparison, with random effects for
study and comparison within study, the shared-reference covariances, and
cluster-robust (CR2) standard errors by study. The 95% prediction interval is
the range of rates expected at a new site, and is the interval to compare with
the spread of the model ensemble.

The inputs are saved with the outputs. `empirical_soc_pairs.csv` has the 0-20 cm
SDs (`sd_cor`, `sd_ind`; `_ref` for the reference) and replicates (`reps`,
`reps_ref`) of each pair, and its rate variance (`var_rate`, `var_rate_ind`).
`empirical_soc_study_means.csv` has the variance of each study's mean rate
(`var_rate_fd`, `var_rate_esm`, `var_rate_fd_ind`).

```{r meta-analysis}
library(metafor)
library(clubSandwich)

top20_sd <- profiles %>%
  semi_join(filter(profile_checks, usable), by = c("paper_id", "sid", "tid")) %>%
  filter(soil_depth_upper < target_depth_cm) %>%
  mutate(layer_sd = total_MgC_ha_sd * pmin(1, (target_depth_cm - soil_depth_upper) / thickness_cm)) %>%
  group_by(paper_id, sid, tid) %>%
  summarise(sd_cor = sum(layer_sd), sd_ind = sqrt(sum(layer_sd^2)), reps = first(reps),
            .groups = "drop")

# SDs (Mg C/ha, 0-20 cm) and replicates of both sides of each pair, and the
# sampling variance of its rate (the same for fixed depth and ESM)
pairs <- pairs %>%
  left_join(top20_sd, by = c("paper_id", "sid", "tid")) %>%
  left_join(rename(top20_sd, ref_paper_id = paper_id, ref_sid = sid, ref_tid = tid,
                   sd_cor_ref = sd_cor, sd_ind_ref = sd_ind, reps_ref = reps),
            by = c("ref_paper_id", "ref_sid", "ref_tid")) %>%
  mutate(var_rate = (sd_cor^2 / reps + sd_cor_ref^2 / reps_ref) / duration^2,
         var_rate_ind = (sd_ind^2 / reps + sd_ind_ref^2 / reps_ref) / duration^2)

ma_pairs <- pairs %>%
  filter(Change %in% names(practice_labels)) %>%
  mutate(comparison = row_number())
stopifnot(!anyNA(select(ma_pairs, sd_cor, sd_cor_ref, reps, reps_ref)))

# Sampling covariance matrix of the rates in d; comparisons with the same
# reference share its variance
rate_vcov <- function(d, sd_col) {
  v_trt <- d[[sd_col]]^2 / d$reps / d$duration^2
  se_ref <- d[[paste0(sd_col, "_ref")]] / sqrt(d$reps_ref) / d$duration
  V <- outer(d$ref_id, d$ref_id, "==") * outer(se_ref, se_ref)
  diag(V) <- diag(V) + v_trt
  V
}

# One effect and variance per study: the mean of its comparisons
study_effects <- function(d, y_col, sd_col) {
  d %>%
    filter(!is.na(.data[[y_col]])) %>%
    group_by(paper_id) %>%
    group_modify(~ tibble(yi = mean(.x[[y_col]]), vi = sum(rate_vcov(.x, sd_col)) / nrow(.x)^2,
                          n_comparisons = nrow(.x))) %>%
    ungroup()
}

# Sampling variance of each study's mean rate, for the study table
study_variance <- function(y_col, sd_col, name) {
  purrr::map_dfr(names(practice_labels), function(ch) {
    study_effects(filter(ma_pairs, Change == ch), y_col, sd_col) %>%
      transmute(paper_id, Change = factor(ch, levels = names(practice_labels)), !!name := vi)
  })
}
study <- study %>%
  left_join(study_variance("rate_fd", "sd_cor", "var_rate_fd"), by = c("paper_id", "Change")) %>%
  left_join(study_variance("rate_esm", "sd_cor", "var_rate_esm"), by = c("paper_id", "Change")) %>%
  left_join(study_variance("rate_fd", "sd_ind", "var_rate_fd_ind"), by = c("paper_id", "Change"))

summarise_fit <- function(fit, k_studies, k_comparisons, ci = c(fit$ci.lb, fit$ci.ub), i2 = fit$I2) {
  pred <- predict(fit)
  tibble(studies = k_studies, comparisons = k_comparisons, estimate = as.numeric(fit$b),
         ci_lb = ci[1], ci_ub = ci[2], pi_lb = pred$pi.lb, pi_ub = pred$pi.ub,
         tau = sqrt(sum(if (inherits(fit, "rma.mv")) fit$sigma2 else fit$tau2)),
         I2 = i2, Q = fit$QE, Q_p = fit$QEp)
}

fit_study_level <- function(d, y_col, sd_col) {
  s <- study_effects(d, y_col, sd_col)
  summarise_fit(rma(yi, vi, data = s, method = "REML", test = "knha"),
                nrow(s), sum(s$n_comparisons))
}

# I2 of a multilevel model (share of total variance from both random effects)
multilevel_i2 <- function(fit) {
  W <- solve(fit$V)
  X <- model.matrix(fit)
  P <- W - W %*% X %*% solve(t(X) %*% W %*% X) %*% t(X) %*% W
  100 * sum(fit$sigma2) / (sum(fit$sigma2) + (fit$k - fit$p) / sum(diag(P)))
}

fit_multilevel <- function(d, y_col, sd_col) {
  d <- filter(d, !is.na(.data[[y_col]]))
  fit <- rma.mv(d[[y_col]], rate_vcov(d, sd_col), random = ~ 1 | paper_id / comparison,
                data = d, method = "REML", test = "t")
  robust <- conf_int(fit, vcov = "CR2", cluster = d$paper_id)
  summarise_fit(fit, n_distinct(d$paper_id), nrow(d), c(robust$CI_L, robust$CI_U),
                multilevel_i2(fit))
}

analyses <- tribble(
  ~analysis,                                         ~fit,             ~y_col,     ~sd_col,
  "Study-level random effects, fixed depth",         fit_study_level,  "rate_fd",  "sd_cor",
  "Study-level random effects, ESM",                 fit_study_level,  "rate_esm", "sd_cor",
  "Multilevel, all comparisons, fixed depth",        fit_multilevel,   "rate_fd",  "sd_cor",
  "Study-level, independent-layer SD, fixed depth",  fit_study_level,  "rate_fd",  "sd_ind")

meta_results <- tidyr::expand_grid(Change = names(practice_labels), analyses) %>%
  mutate(result = purrr::pmap(list(Change, fit, y_col, sd_col), function(ch, f, y, s)
    f(filter(ma_pairs, Change == ch), y, s))) %>%
  select(Change, analysis, result) %>%
  tidyr::unnest(result) %>%
  bind_rows(study %>%
              pivot_longer(c(rate_fd, rate_esm), names_to = "method", values_to = "rate") %>%
              filter(!is.na(rate)) %>%
              group_by(Change = as.character(Change),
                       analysis = paste0("Unweighted study mean, ",
                                         ifelse(method == "rate_fd", "fixed depth", "ESM"))) %>%
              summarise(studies = n(), comparisons = sum(n_comparisons), estimate = mean(rate),
                        ci_lb = estimate - qt(0.975, studies - 1) * sd(rate) / sqrt(studies),
                        ci_ub = estimate + qt(0.975, studies - 1) * sd(rate) / sqrt(studies),
                        .groups = "drop")) %>%
  mutate(Change = factor(Change, levels = names(practice_labels))) %>%
  mutate(analysis = factor(analysis, levels = c(analyses$analysis,
                                                "Unweighted study mean, fixed depth",
                                                "Unweighted study mean, ESM"))) %>%
  arrange(Change, analysis)

write.csv(meta_results, "meta_analysis_results.csv", row.names = FALSE)

knitr::kable(meta_results %>% mutate(across(c(estimate:tau, Q), ~ round(.x, 3)),
                                     I2 = round(I2, 1), Q_p = signif(Q_p, 2)),
             caption = paste("Net SOC rate (Mg C/ha/yr). CI: 95% confidence interval of the mean;",
                             "PI: 95% prediction interval for a new site; tau: between-study SD."))
```

```{r forest-plot, fig.width=9, fig.height=10}
forest_studies <- purrr::map_dfr(names(practice_labels), function(ch) {
  study_effects(filter(ma_pairs, Change == ch), "rate_fd", "sd_cor") %>%
    mutate(Change = ch)
}) %>%
  left_join(distinct(study, paper_id, Change = as.character(Change), duration),
            by = c("paper_id", "Change")) %>%
  mutate(label = paste0("Paper ", paper_id, " (", round(duration), " yr)"),
         ci_lb = yi - 1.96 * sqrt(vi), ci_ub = yi + 1.96 * sqrt(vi))

forest_pooled <- meta_results %>%
  filter(analysis == "Study-level random effects, fixed depth") %>%
  mutate(Change = as.character(Change), label = "Random-effects mean")

# Rows run from the shortest study at the top to the pooled mean at the bottom
forest_data <- bind_rows(forest_studies, rename(forest_pooled, yi = estimate)) %>%
  mutate(row = ifelse(label == "Random-effects mean", "pooled", "study"),
         Change = factor(Change, levels = names(practice_labels))) %>%
  arrange(Change, row, desc(duration)) %>%
  mutate(key = factor(paste(Change, label), levels = unique(paste(Change, label))))

ggplot(forest_data, aes(x = yi, y = key, color = Change)) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, color = "#b5b4ae") +
  geom_errorbar(data = filter(forest_data, row == "pooled"),
                aes(xmin = pi_lb, xmax = pi_ub), orientation = "y", width = 0, linewidth = 0.6,
                linetype = "dashed") +
  geom_errorbar(aes(xmin = ci_lb, xmax = ci_ub), orientation = "y", width = 0, linewidth = 0.7) +
  geom_point(aes(size = row, shape = row)) +
  scale_y_discrete(labels = setNames(forest_data$label, forest_data$key)) +
  scale_size_manual(values = c(pooled = 3.5, study = 2), guide = "none") +
  scale_shape_manual(values = c(pooled = 18, study = 16), guide = "none") +
  scale_color_manual(values = practice_colors, guide = "none") +
  facet_grid(Change ~ ., scales = "free_y", space = "free_y",
             labeller = labeller(Change = practice_labels)) +
  labs(x = expression(Net~SOC~rate~(Mg~C~ha^-1~yr^-1)), y = NULL,
       caption = paste("Fixed depth 0-20 cm, one effect per study with its 95% CI.",
                       "\nDiamond: random-effects mean (95% CI, Knapp-Hartung);",
                       "dashed: 95% prediction interval for a new site.")) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(panel.grid.minor = element_blank(), plot.caption = element_text(hjust = 0))
```

## DayCent model results (current Project_CABBI pipeline)

The default model run is UAN20, site-specific history, continuous management,
observed weather, and the default DEC4 (0.0025). Its net SOC is the somsc
difference from the default continuous conventional at the same N rate and
history (`cf_conv`), divided by the years since 2020, in Mg C/ha/yr; this
mirrors the empirical treatment-minus-control rate. Sensitivity points use the
30-year SOC-only, per-area credits from `accounting_results.csv` (somsc,
`cf_conv`, default DEC4), converted back to Mg C. They include the set-aside
scenarios (other N rates, cycling and adopt-then-revert patterns), which are
credited against the default conventional. The alternative conventional
definitions (`convplow`, `convrt`) are counterfactuals, not practices, and are
left out here.

```{r model}
annual <- read.csv(file.path(model_dir, "daycent_annual_summary.csv"))

model_default <- annual %>%
  filter(conservation_practice %in% c("conv", tolower(names(practice_labels))),
         n_rate == "n_obs", historic_land_use == "hlu_site", cycling_frequency == "cont",
         weather_sequence == "w_obs", dec4 == "dec4_def", year >= 2020, year <= 2050) %>%
  select(conservation_practice, year, somsc_mg_c_ha)
conv <- model_default %>% filter(conservation_practice == "conv") %>%
  select(year, conv_somsc = somsc_mg_c_ha)
model_curve <- model_default %>%
  filter(conservation_practice != "conv") %>%
  inner_join(conv, by = "year") %>%
  mutate(Change = toupper(conservation_practice),
         years = year - 2020,
         diff_mg_c_ha = somsc_mg_c_ha - conv_somsc) %>%
  group_by(Change) %>%
  mutate(diff_mg_c_ha = diff_mg_c_ha - diff_mg_c_ha[years == 0]) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  filter(years > 0) %>%
  mutate(rate_model = diff_mg_c_ha / years,
         Change = factor(Change, levels = names(practice_labels)))

stopifnot(nrow(model_curve) == 30 * length(practice_labels))
model_30 <- model_curve %>% filter(years == 30) %>% select(Change, rate_model)

# Sensitivity: other N rates, histories, cycling and reversion (30 years)
credits <- read.csv(file.path(model_dir, "accounting_results.csv"))
model_sensitivity <- credits %>%
  filter(carbon_pool == "somsc", counterfactual == "cf_conv", horizon_years == 30,
         n2o_option == "none", functional_unit == "area", weather_sequence == "w_obs",
         dec4 == "dec4_def") %>%
  mutate(Change = factor(toupper(conservation_practice), levels = names(practice_labels)),
         rate_model = soc_benefit_mg_co2e_ha_yr / c_to_co2,
         PointCategory = case_when(
           n_rate == "n_obs" & historic_land_use == "hlu_site" & cycling_frequency == "cont" ~ "Modeled",
           n_rate != "n_obs" & historic_land_use == "hlu_site" & cycling_frequency == "cont" ~ "Modeled - Alt N Fert Rate",
           n_rate == "n_obs" & historic_land_use != "hlu_site" & cycling_frequency == "cont" ~ "Modeled - Alt HLU",
           n_rate == "n_obs" & historic_land_use == "hlu_site" & grepl("^rev", cycling_frequency) ~ "Modeled - Cycle",
           n_rate == "n_obs" & historic_land_use == "hlu_site" & grepl("^adopt", cycling_frequency) ~ "Modeled - Revert",
           TRUE ~ NA_character_)) %>%
  filter(!is.na(PointCategory)) %>%
  select(Change, PointCategory, n_rate, historic_land_use, cycling_frequency, rate_model)

# The default sensitivity point must equal the default curve at 30 years
stopifnot(isTRUE(all.equal(
  model_sensitivity %>% filter(PointCategory == "Modeled") %>% arrange(Change) %>% pull(rate_model),
  model_30 %>% arrange(Change) %>% pull(rate_model), tolerance = 1e-4)))  # credits are written rounded

```

## Match each study to the model at the same duration

The model's per-year rate changes with time, so each study is compared with
the default model rate at the study's duration. Studies longer than the
30-year model run have no matched value.

```{r matched}
study <- study %>%
  mutate(years = round(duration)) %>%
  left_join(model_curve %>% select(Change, years, rate_model_matched = rate_model),
            by = c("Change", "years"))

cat("Studies with a matched model value:", sum(!is.na(study$rate_model_matched)), "of",
    nrow(study), "\n")
```

```{r compare-boxplot, fig.width=10, fig.height=5.5}
study_long <- study %>%
  pivot_longer(c(rate_fd, rate_esm), names_to = "method", values_to = "rate") %>%
  filter(!is.na(rate)) %>%
  mutate(method = factor(ifelse(method == "rate_fd", "Fixed depth (0-20 cm)",
                                "Equivalent soil mass"),
                         levels = c("Fixed depth (0-20 cm)", "Equivalent soil mass")))

study_counts <- study_long %>% count(method, Change)

sensitivity_colors <- c("Modeled - Alt N Fert Rate" = "#eda100", "Modeled - Alt HLU" = "#6250d6",
                        "Modeled - Cycle" = "#1baf7a", "Modeled - Revert" = "#e87ba4")

ggplot(study_long, aes(x = Change, y = rate)) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, color = "#b5b4ae") +
  geom_boxplot(outlier.shape = NA, color = "#52514e", width = 0.55) +
  geom_point(color = "#52514e", alpha = 0.6, position = position_jitter(width = 0.08, seed = 1)) +
  stat_summary(fun = mean, geom = "point", shape = 23, size = 3, fill = "black") +
  geom_point(data = model_sensitivity %>% filter(PointCategory != "Modeled"),
             aes(y = rate_model, color = PointCategory),
             position = position_nudge(x = 0.38), size = 1.8) +
  geom_point(data = model_30, aes(y = rate_model), color = "#e34948", size = 4,
             position = position_nudge(x = 0.38)) +
  geom_text(data = study_counts, aes(y = -Inf, label = paste0("n=", n)), vjust = -0.5,

  scale_x_discrete(labels = practice_labels) +
  scale_color_manual(name = "30-yr model sensitivity", values = sensitivity_colors) +
  labs(x = NULL, y = expression(Net~SOC~accumulation~(Mg~C~ha^-1~yr^-1)),
       caption = paste("Box/points: study-level empirical rates (black diamond = mean).",
                       "Red: default model, 30 years.",
                       "n = studies after averaging comparisons within each paper.")) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(legend.position = "bottom")
```

## Summary table

```{r summary-table}
summary_table <- study_long %>%
  group_by(method, Change) %>%
  summarise(studies = n(),
            mean = mean(rate), median = median(rate),
            q25 = quantile(rate, 0.25), q75 = quantile(rate, 0.75),
            mean_duration = mean(duration), .groups = "drop") %>%
  left_join(model_30 %>% rename(model_30yr = rate_model), by = "Change") %>%
  left_join(matched_long %>% group_by(method, Change) %>%
              summarise(model_matched_mean = mean(rate_model_matched),
                        empirical_matched_mean = mean(rate), matched_studies = n(),
                        .groups = "drop"),
            by = c("method", "Change")) %>%
  mutate(across(c(mean, median, q25, q75, model_30yr, model_matched_mean,
                  empirical_matched_mean), ~ round(.x, 3)),
         mean_t_co2e = round(mean * c_to_co2, 3),
         model_30yr_t_co2e = round(model_30yr * c_to_co2, 3))

knitr::kable(summary_table,
             caption = "Net SOC accumulation, Mg C/ha/yr (t CO2e/ha/yr = Mg C x 44/12)")
```

## Covariates for mixed-effects models

Each comparison is joined to site, experiment, management, and soil variables
from the original dataset, so the net SOC change can be modeled with
covariates (for example, a mixed model with a random intercept for study).

- Site and experiment variables (climate, location, design, SOC method) are
  constant within a trial and taken from the treatment trial.
- Management variables are given for the treatment and, with the suffix
  `_ref`, for its reference, plus differences where useful.
- N fertilizer: `avg_Nfert_rate` is empty in the dataset, so `corn_Nfert_rate`
  is the rate reported for the corn crop and `mean_crop_Nfert_rate` the mean of
  the rates reported for the rotation's crops (kg N ha⁻¹ yr⁻¹; not a
  rotation-weighted annual rate).
- Layer variables (bulk density, pH, texture) are 0-20 cm means weighted by
  layer thickness within 0-20 cm; MAOC and POC stocks are prorated to 0-20 cm
  like total SOC.

`empirical_soc_pairs_covariates.csv` has one row per comparison (including the
rotation-only comparisons, `Change == "Conv"`), and
`empirical_soc_study_covariates.csv` one row per study per practice (numeric
covariates averaged and text covariates listed across the study's
comparisons). `empirical_covariates_dictionary.csv` defines each column.

```{r covariates}
pair_keys <- bind_rows(distinct(pairs, paper_id, sid, tid),
                       distinct(pairs, paper_id = ref_paper_id, sid = ref_sid, tid = ref_tid)) %>%
  distinct()

# N fertilizer rate of the corn crop and mean over the rotation's crops
species_cols <- paste0("crop", 1:8, "_species")
n_cols <- paste0("crop", 1:5, "_Nfert_rate")
trial_rows <- dd %>% semi_join(pair_keys, by = c("paper_id", "sid", "tid"))
corn_index <- apply(as.matrix(trial_rows[species_cols]), 1, function(r) match("corn", r))
n_rates <- as.matrix(trial_rows[n_cols])
trial_rows$corn_Nfert_rate <- ifelse(corn_index <= length(n_cols),
                                     n_rates[cbind(seq_len(nrow(n_rates)), pmin(corn_index, length(n_cols)))],
                                     NA_real_)
trial_rows$mean_crop_Nfert_rate <- ifelse(rowSums(!is.na(n_rates)) > 0, rowMeans(n_rates, na.rm = TRUE), NA_real_)

wmean <- function(x, w) if (all(is.na(x))) NA_real_ else weighted.mean(x, w, na.rm = TRUE)
prorated_sum <- function(x, share) if (anyNA(x)) NA_real_ else sum(x * share)

trial_cov <- trial_rows %>%
  mutate(w_0_20 = pmax(0, pmin(soil_depth_lower, target_depth_cm) - soil_depth_upper),
         share_0_20 = w_0_20 / (soil_depth_lower - soil_depth_upper)) %>%
  group_by(paper_id, sid, tid) %>%
  summarise(across(c(tillage, tillage_details, tillage_depth, tillage_freq, crop_rotation_name,
                     total_cropping_intensity, crop_diversity, perennial, CC, crop_scsc, rotation_scsc,
                     livestock_integration, corn_Nfert_rate, mean_crop_Nfert_rate), first),
            bd_0_20 = wmean(soil_BD[w_0_20 > 0], w_0_20[w_0_20 > 0]),
            ph_0_20 = wmean(soil_pH[w_0_20 > 0], w_0_20[w_0_20 > 0]),
            sand_0_20 = wmean(per_sand[w_0_20 > 0], w_0_20[w_0_20 > 0]),
            silt_0_20 = wmean(per_silt[w_0_20 > 0], w_0_20[w_0_20 > 0]),
            clay_0_20 = wmean(per_clay[w_0_20 > 0], w_0_20[w_0_20 > 0]),
            maoc_MgC_ha_0_20 = prorated_sum(maoc_MgC_ha[w_0_20 > 0], share_0_20[w_0_20 > 0]),
            poc_MgC_ha_0_20 = prorated_sum(poc_MgC_ha[w_0_20 > 0], share_0_20[w_0_20 > 0]),
            sampled_depth_cm = max(soil_depth_lower),
            layers_0_20 = sum(w_0_20 > 0),
            .groups = "drop")

site_cov <- trial_rows %>%
  group_by(paper_id, sid, tid) %>%
  summarise(across(c(author, year, country, continent, state, location, lat_x, long_x, MAT, MAP, PET, climate,
                     soil_type, field_history, year_est, exp_design, exp_arrangement, reps, plot_width,
                     plot_length, SOC_determination_method), first),
            .groups = "drop") %>%
  rename(publication_year = year, latitude = lat_x, longitude = long_x) %>%
  mutate(plot_area_m2 = plot_width * plot_length) %>%
  select(-plot_width, -plot_length)

pairs_cov <- pairs %>%
  select(paper_id, sid, tid, ref_paper_id, ref_sid, ref_tid, ref_id, Change, duration,
         soc_0_20 = MgC_ha_top20_fd, soc_0_20_ref = MgC_ha_top20_fd_ref, delta_fd, rate_fd,
         soc_esm = MgC_ha_esm, esm_extrapolated, delta_esm, rate_esm, var_rate, var_rate_ind) %>%
  left_join(site_cov, by = c("paper_id", "sid", "tid")) %>%
  left_join(trial_cov, by = c("paper_id", "sid", "tid")) %>%
  left_join(rename_with(trial_cov, ~ paste0(.x, "_ref"), -c(paper_id, sid, tid)),
            by = c("ref_paper_id" = "paper_id", "ref_sid" = "sid", "ref_tid" = "tid")) %>%
  mutate(same_rotation = crop_rotation_name == crop_rotation_name_ref,
         corn_Nfert_diff = corn_Nfert_rate - corn_Nfert_rate_ref,
         bd_0_20_diff = bd_0_20 - bd_0_20_ref,
         maoc_share_0_20_ref = maoc_MgC_ha_0_20_ref / (maoc_MgC_ha_0_20_ref + poc_MgC_ha_0_20_ref))
stopifnot(nrow(pairs_cov) == nrow(pairs))

# One row per study per practice: numeric covariates averaged, text listed
collapse_text <- function(x) { x <- unique(na.omit(as.character(x))); if (length(x)) paste(x, collapse = "; ") else NA_character_ }
mean_or_na <- function(x) if (all(is.na(x))) NA_real_ else mean(x, na.rm = TRUE)
study_cov <- pairs_cov %>%
  filter(Change %in% names(practice_labels)) %>%
  select(-c(tid, ref_paper_id, ref_sid, ref_tid, ref_id, duration, delta_fd, rate_fd, delta_esm, rate_esm,
            var_rate, var_rate_ind, soc_esm, esm_extrapolated)) %>%
  group_by(paper_id, Change) %>%
  summarise(across(where(is.numeric), mean_or_na),
            across(where(is.logical), ~ mean(.x, na.rm = TRUE)),
            across(where(is.character), collapse_text), .groups = "drop") %>%
  rename(sids = sid)
study_cov <- study %>%
  mutate(Change = as.character(Change)) %>%
  left_join(study_cov %>% select(-any_of(c("location"))), by = c("paper_id", "Change"))
stopifnot(nrow(study_cov) == nrow(study))

dictionary <- tribble(
  ~column, ~description, ~units,
  "paper_id / sid / tid", "Study, site, and treatment IDs in the Global SOC Fractions dataset", "",
  "ref_*", "IDs of the reference (conventional) trial; ref_id is the hand-assigned reference group", "",
  "Change", "Practice change relative to the reference (NT, RT, CC; Conv = rotation only, excluded from analyses)", "",
  "duration", "Years since the treatments were established", "yr",
  "soc_0_20, soc_0_20_ref", "SOC stock, 0-20 cm, treatment and reference", "Mg C ha-1",
  "delta_fd, rate_fd", "Net SOC change (treatment minus reference), fixed depth; and divided by duration", "Mg C ha-1; Mg C ha-1 yr-1",
  "soc_esm, delta_esm, rate_esm", "Treatment SOC at the reference's 0-20 cm soil mass; net change; rate", "Mg C ha-1; Mg C ha-1 yr-1",
  "esm_extrapolated", "ESM needed extrapolation below the treatment's deepest layer", "",
  "var_rate, var_rate_ind", "Sampling variance of the rate (layer SDs summed / combined as independent)", "(Mg C ha-1 yr-1)^2",
  "author, publication_year, country, continent, state, location, latitude, longitude", "Study and site", "",
  "MAT, MAP, PET", "Mean annual temperature, precipitation, potential evapotranspiration", "deg C; mm yr-1; mm yr-1",
  "climate, soil_type, field_history", "Climate class, soil type as reported, land use before the experiment", "",
  "year_est, exp_design, exp_arrangement, reps, plot_area_m2", "Experiment establishment year, design, replicates, plot area", "yr; ; ; ; m2",
  "SOC_determination_method", "Dry combustion or wet oxidation", "",
  "tillage, tillage_details, tillage_depth, tillage_freq", "Tillage system, implements, depth, passes per year", "; ; cm; yr-1",
  "crop_rotation_name, total_cropping_intensity, crop_diversity, perennial, CC, crop_scsc, rotation_scsc", "Rotation, cropping intensity, species count, perennial and cover crop indicators", "",
  "livestock_integration", "Crop-livestock integration indicator", "",
  "corn_Nfert_rate", "N fertilizer rate reported for the corn crop", "kg N ha-1 yr-1",
  "mean_crop_Nfert_rate", "Mean of the N rates reported for the rotation's crops (not rotation-weighted)", "kg N ha-1 yr-1",
  "bd_0_20, ph_0_20, sand_0_20, silt_0_20, clay_0_20", "Thickness-weighted 0-20 cm mean bulk density, pH, texture", "g cm-3; ; %; %; %",
  "maoc_MgC_ha_0_20, poc_MgC_ha_0_20", "Mineral-associated and particulate organic C stocks prorated to 0-20 cm", "Mg C ha-1",
  "sampled_depth_cm, layers_0_20", "Deepest sampled depth; number of layers within 0-20 cm", "cm; ",
  "*_ref", "The same management or soil variable for the reference trial", "",
  "same_rotation", "Treatment and reference have the same crop rotation (study file: share of comparisons)", "",
  "corn_Nfert_diff, bd_0_20_diff", "Treatment minus reference corn N rate and 0-20 cm bulk density", "kg N ha-1 yr-1; g cm-3",
  "maoc_share_0_20_ref", "MAOC share of MAOC + POC in the reference, 0-20 cm", "fraction",
  "n_comparisons, n_esm (study file)", "Comparisons averaged into the study point; those with ESM", ""
)

write.csv(pairs_cov, "empirical_soc_pairs_covariates.csv", row.names = FALSE)
write.csv(study_cov, "empirical_soc_study_covariates.csv", row.names = FALSE)
write.csv(dictionary, "empirical_covariates_dictionary.csv", row.names = FALSE)

# Coverage of each covariate among the 54 NT/RT/CC comparisons
coverage <- pairs_cov %>%
  filter(Change %in% names(practice_labels)) %>%
  summarise(across(everything(), ~ round(100 * mean(!is.na(.x) & as.character(.x) != "")))) %>%
  pivot_longer(everything(), names_to = "column", values_to = "percent_available") %>%
  arrange(percent_available)
knitr::kable(coverage %>% filter(percent_available < 100),
             caption = "Covariates not available for every NT/RT/CC comparison (% of 54 comparisons)")
```

## Notes

- Comparisons are used as assigned in the reference file, including pairs whose
  rotation differs from the reference beyond the practice change.
- Durations are years since the practice began; dividing the paired difference
  by duration assumes treatment and reference started from the same SOC.
- The empirical studies are global, while the model is one Illinois site.
- The archived notebook (`archive/SOCMetaAnalysis_2025-11-12.Rmd`) keeps the
  earlier exploratory sections (GRACEnet, literature values, the von Haden ESM
  example, and the original plots).
